_about: What the reel editor may SHOW as a live CRWN capability. A CRWN product visual is only allowed for a capability listed here with status 'shipped', whose evidence paths exist in this repo (capabilities.test.mjs checks them, so deleting a feature fails the suite instead of reaching a reel), and whose words the script line actually says. The script's own META 'CRWN claim tier' still gates first: a 'conceptual' tier gets typography, never product UI. Add a capability here only after checking the code.

set_price.label: You set the price
set_price.match: set the (top rung|price)|you set|price (it|them) yourself|a number you picked

fan_crm.label: Your fan list, in one place
fan_crm.match: fan (list|crm)|who (actually )?(pays|bought)|the list of who|one place|buyer comes with the sale|your list|names

share_to_earn.label: Share-to-Earn
share_to_earn.match: share-to-earn|share link|cut they earn|earn on every|referral

release_waterfall.label: Release waterfall
release_waterfall.match: waterfall|highest tier first|hears? it first|early access|before (anybody|everybody|the public)

neverClaim._about: Things CRWN does not do. A CRWN beat whose line reads as one of these gets typography only, and QA flags it. Sources: CLAUDE.md (no physical goods 2026-09-03, nobody books an artist 2026-09-03) and the scripts' own claim-tier notes.
